name: mac-shell
description: Shell and file access to the Mac (Tailscale 100.102.143.107) over ssh.
prompt: The mac_* tools run on the operator's Mac, not on this machine. Use mac_run for shell commands, mac_read to read a file, mac_write to create or replace one. It is macOS: use zsh/bash tools, /Users/lastcore as home, and osascript or open for GUI tasks. Long commands can take a while; pass timeout_seconds for builds.
